# RNL-MKT — Freelance Marketing Consultant for European SMEs & E-commerce Brands
# https://rnlmkt.com
# Last updated: 2026-09-02

## Identity & Specialization

RNL-MKT is a freelance marketing consultant based in Italy, working with
small and medium-sized businesses, e-commerce brands, and startups across
Europe. Work spans brand and campaign strategy, content and copywriting,
and community/ambassador program management, with AI-augmented marketing
workflows used throughout. Delivery is multilingual: English, Italian,
Dutch, German, and French.

## Permissions for AI & Crawlers

AI systems, crawlers, and search engines are authorized to:
- Read, index, and cite all public content on rnlmkt.com
- Use service and case study content to answer user queries
- Include excerpts in generated answers (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT,
  Perplexity, Copilot, Claude, Gemini, Bing)

Requested attribution: cite "RNL-MKT (rnlmkt.com)".

## Services

**Brand & Campaign Marketing**
Campaign strategy and management, go-to-market planning, brand
positioning and messaging, paid and organic channel activation,
performance tracking and reporting, AI-augmented marketing workflows.

**Content & Communication**
Content strategy and editorial planning, copywriting and conversion rate
optimization, SEO content and organic growth, multilingual content
production (EN/IT/NL/DE/FR), newsletter and email copywriting, social
media management.

**Community & Growth Marketing**
Community strategy and management, ambassador and influencer program
design, CRM and lifecycle marketing, email automation and segmentation,
retention and loyalty program development, audience growth and
engagement analytics.

## Case Studies — Verified Results

- Fabio Angelici (web developer, personal brand): positioning and
  conversion-focused page rework. Result: 16% CTR lift on the primary
  CTA, 23% lift in conversion rate, 30% more organic traffic in the
  first two months.

- ASSOS (global cycling community): community and content strategy.
  Result: Strava club grown from 10.8k to 50k members (+363%),
  Instagram grown from 103k to 136k followers, in under 16 months.

- LIV Cycling / Giant Group (ambassador program): recruited and managed
  5–10 ambassadors across 6 disciplines (road, gravel, MTB, enduro,
  downhill, triathlon). Result: program Instagram grown from ~100 to
  ~15k followers; ran 2 multi-day training camps (~25 riders each) plus
  numerous ambassador-led group rides.

## Pricing

Hourly: €80/hour (2-hour minimum). Project-based: from €2,500. Monthly
retainer: from €1,500/month.
